title: Run an exploratory model search — shoot
text: Every shoot wall-clock budget (default 30s). Modifiers pre-rolled run start default: shoot() picks random per- transition loadout (+glmm, +derived_metrics, ...) applies one matching mascot state transition fires, extending deadline modifier's per-token bonus (2-5s) redirecting search priority. Pass interactive_modifiers = TRUE opt readline tactical-prompt window transition instead. Without +derived_metrics, runs fail clear p <= 0.05 simply lose — highlighted spec stays threshold output gauntlet open. Output flags (abstract, manuscript, presentation / powerpoint, reviewer_response / reviewer, graphical_abstract / graphical, funding) auto-generate matching file run shippable. chain prefix needed reach highest enabled flag generated order: e.g. presentation = TRUE produces abstract, manuscript, presentation.

title: Package options for texanshootR — texanshootR-options
text: texanshootR.animations Logical. Enable terminal animations ANSI cursor effects. Default: TRUE. Forced non-interactive sessions terminal lacks ANSI support. texanshootR.output_dir Character NULL. Default directory output files. NULL falls back tempdir(). texanshootR.save_enabled Logical. Enable persistent career data. FALSE runs entirely memory. Default: TRUE. texanshootR.quiet Logical. Suppress status prints output functions. Default: FALSE. texanshootR.event_rate Numeric [0, 1]. Per-run probability life-event encounter. Default: 1/6. texanshootR.life_events Logical. Enable life-event encounters runs. Default: TRUE. texanshootR.ui_mode Optional character override TUI rendering mode. One "ansi", "dynamic", "plain". Unset (default) means auto-detect. Use auto-detect picks wrong mode terminal (e.g., remote RStudio session report .Platform$GUI == "RStudio").

Methods sentence rendered consistently across print(run) every output generator via shared describe_spec() helper. summary(run) reports counts axis. run_log(): persisted history recorded runs. Reproducibility: every run records seed, R version, package version, hash search grid.
